method.progression: Controlled fixtures; no claim that these exact builds are obtainable at each stage
pilots: circle: fixed route, proximity dash and pulse
reactive: keeps its distance, leaves soon-armed zones, sidesteps shots, pulses crowds
method.fresh: Start of a run (mechanic, starting kit, no residents); battles and elites use one seed per squad template
method.ends: cleared: squad broken; overtime: squad fight clock ran out; leader: boss or miniboss killed; timeout / lost: defeat
method.economy: Random connected routes assuming all fights won, guaranteed combat/boss gold only; excludes purchases, drops and event gold

gates.id: stationary ends location 1 step 3 below 50% hp
circle ends a location 1 elite below 80% hp
reactive beats circle on location 1 elites
moving pilots win the first fight above 60% hp
first level within 20 s of the first fight
won location 1 squad fights end on the kill quota, not the clock (%)
